headline: For the exact-spectrum lightlike two-heavy family Q=V^2-2US, the completed weak-L^(3/2) kernel theorem extends uniformly to arbitrary Gaussian bank shifts H and variance sigma>=1/sqrt(12), with ceiling C_x(sigma_0/sigma)^(2/3). A source-valid symmetric growing-activity fragmented bank has sigma^2->1/12+a^2 and uniform local density convergence, giving limsup peak <= C_x(1+12a^2)^(-1/3)<3sqrt(2), uniformly over arbitrary m-dependent cap-one heavy laws.
exact_matrix: A_m=R_m B R_m^T, R_m^T R_m=I_3, B=I-2uu^T with u=(1/2,1/2,1/sqrt(2)); exact nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1}; Q=V^2-2US_m.
fragment_law: epsilon_m=lambda_m/m, D_m=a sqrt(m/lambda_m), lambda_m->infinity, lambda_m=o(m); f_m=(1-epsilon_m)1_[-1/2,1/2]+unit-height symmetric remote intervals of total length epsilon_m centered at +/-D_m. It is a cap-one probability density with unbounded/disconnected support diameter.

remaining_gap: The unrestricted QFORM theorem and the sharp universal constant remain open. The next sharp-witness class should leave the lightlike two-heavy mechanism: non-lightlike two-heavy geometry with residual bank curvature, two or more interacting diffuse banks, non-Gaussian non-shift limits, or another finite/mesoscopic coupled construction.
